research_notes: Authored from: Wikipedia shooter-game taxonomy (FPS, arena, hero, tactical, looter, boomer shooter subgenres), FPS combat/level-design principles (Game Developer design coverage), classic FPS movement/weapon/health model knowledge (Doom/Quake/Halo/CS conventions). Jev unmatched-answer tolerance: questions the prompt says nothing about.

fps_subgenre.instructions: Which FPS subgenre does the request most resemble?

criteria.boomer_arcade: fast movement, hordes of enemies, pickups on floor, Doom and Quake style
criteria.modern_arena: one enclosed arena, escalating waves, score chasing
criteria.tactical: slow careful combat, limited ammo, one shot can kill, cover discipline
criteria.horror_ambient: dark corridors, scarce resources, dread and vulnerability
criteria.looter_run: runs that earn gear and upgrades between attempts

fps_subgenre.fallback: default to boomer_arcade movement with modern_arena structure

movement_speed.instructions: How fast does the player move?

criteria.ultra_fast: very high speed like Quake or Dusk, constant motion
criteria.brisk: quick but controlled like Doom 2016 or Halo
criteria.measured: moderate realism pace like CS or stalker-like games
criteria.slow_cautious: heavy careful steps, horror or tactical pace

movement_tech.instructions: What advanced movement tools does the request imply?

criteria.sprint_slide: sprint with slide or crouch slide feel
criteria.dash_dodge: quick dash bursts or dodge rolls
criteria.airmobility: double jump, air strafing, rocket or grapple mobility

verticality.instructions: How much vertical gameplay does the map need?

criteria.multi_level: two or three levels, catwalks and stairs
criteria.towers_holes: tall towers, pits, overlooks and underground parts

weapons_ranged.instructions: What weapon types should the player carry?

criteria.hitscan_set: instant hitscan guns pistol rifle shotgun sniper
criteria.projectile_set: in-flight projectiles rockets grenades plasma arrows
criteria.energy_exotic: beams, chain lightning, portals, sci-fi oddities
criteria.melee_heavy: melee as a real option, claws chainsaw sword
criteria.mixed_all: one hitscan one explosive one energy spread across slots

weapon_slots.instructions: How many weapons can be held at once?

criteria.all_arsenal: carry everything found, quake and doom style
criteria.two_slots: only two weapons equipped at a time
criteria.one_primary: one weapon at a time, forced swapping

criteria.pew_casual: no recoil, pure arcade fun, pattern-free
criteria.moderate_kick: mild recoil and spread growth on sustained fire
criteria.tactical_burst: strong recoil, tap and burst firing rewarded

criteria.infinite: no ammo, only weapon cooldowns if any
criteria.finite_pickups: ammo is finite, replenished by pickups and drops
criteria.battery_heat: energy or heat system instead of ammo

enemy_archetypes.instructions: Which enemy roster is being asked for?

criteria.ranged_mixed: shooters plus rushers forming classic duos
criteria.armor_variety: shielded armored and weakpoint enemies mixed
criteria.humanoids_squad: soldier squad AI using cover and flanks

criteria.tactical_cover: use cover, retreat when hurt, flank occasionally
criteria.swarm_overwhelm: individually dumb, dangerous only in numbers

wave_or_boss_structure.instructions: What match structure drives the game?

criteria.wave_arena: waves of enemies clearing into the next wave
criteria.boss_first: one big boss encounter as the main event
criteria.linear_corridor: rooms sequenced like a campaign mission
criteria.open_explore: one explorable zone with objectives scattered

boss_fight.instructions: Does the request imply a giant boss or final enemy?

criteria.true: boss, giant, mothership, final duel, big bad mentioned
criteria.false: no boss or final encounter mentioned

health_model.instructions: What health and recovery system fits?

criteria.pickups_only: health only comes from kits on the ground
criteria.regen_slow: health slowly regenerates after no damage
criteria.low_health_grit: tiny health pool, deaths fast, restart quick

player_damage_feel.instructions: How should taking damage express itself?

criteria.red_vignette: red edges of screen and heartbeat
criteria.tiny_death: near-instant death with no drawn out hurt

arena_setting.instructions: What setting or environment theme does the request suggest?

criteria.sci_fi_station: space station, sci-fi corridors and hangars
criteria.urban_warzone: city streets, ruined buildings, war rubble
criteria.abstract_grid: abstract geometric arena like tron or superhot

lighting_mood.instructions: What lighting atmosphere fits the mood?

criteria.bright_clean: well lit, visibility first, arcade readability
criteria.neon_glow: emissive neon surfaces and fog with bloom

camera_fx.instructions: What first-person camera effects should exist?

criteria.none_static: steady camera, no bob or tilt
criteria.full_juice: bob, strafe tilt, landing kick, FOV kick on dash

criteria.minimal_dots: nearly nothing, diegetic or tiny corner dot
criteria.classic_bars: health bar, ammo counter, wave number corners
criteria.sci_fi_overlay: stylish futuristic frame with animated meters

crosshair_style.instructions: What aiming reticle fits the game feel?

criteria.static_cross: simple fixed crosshair always same size
criteria.hit_markers: dynamic crosshair plus hit confirm markers

difficulty_pillars.instructions: What difficulty stance should the game take?

criteria.casual_fun: easy to survive, spectacle over challenge
criteria.hardcore_punishing: fast death, mastery demanded, few checkpoints

session_shape.instructions: What session length does the request imply?

criteria.instant_burst: one to three minute runs, instant restart

criteria.synth_darksynth: dark synthwave pulses, Carpenter Brut energy
criteria.chunky_arcade: punchy arcade pops, zaps and booms

persistence.instructions: What should be saved between sessions?

criteria.run_stats: detailed stats, weapon choices, run history saved

loot_or_upgrades.instructions: Does the run include mid-combat upgrades or loot?

criteria.pickups_only: health, ammo and powerup pickups on map
criteria.perk_choices: choose an upgrade perk between waves

engine_fidelity.instructions: What 3D implementation depth fits the request and constraint reality?

criteria.minimal_shapes: simple colored boxes and cylinders, stylized
criteria.low_poly_flair: low-poly models with lights, fog, particles

file_structure.instructions: What packaging scale fits the ask?

criteria.single_html: one self-contained html file using CDN three.js
criteria.small_project: a few files with local web server

objective_extra.instructions: Beyond shooting enemies, what secondary goal does the prompt imply?

criteria.none_survive: nothing extra, survival is the goal
criteria.collect_items: fetch or collect objects in the map
criteria.defend_object: protect something that can be damaged

hit_feedback_enemies.instructions: How should enemy hits and deaths register visually?

criteria.flash_only: flash white on hit, shrink and vanish
criteria.particles_gib: explode into particles upon death and hit
criteria.ragdoll_physics: physical collapse with ragdoll or knockback
